Now I understand the vulnerability clearly. The OOB read is in `make_hI()` at line:
```c
hI[j][i] = k - 1 + (i - hl[j][k - 1]) /
    (hl[j][k] - hl[j][k - 1]);
```

When `k=0`, `hl[j][-1]` is accessed, which is an out-of-bounds read.
